title: coleus megacalyx
intro: Coleus megacalyx, commonly known as the "red flame" plant, is a type of flowering plant in the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of Coleus megacalyx include its ability to reduce pain, lower blood pressure, and prevent the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
